systems.tiers: Per Burkina Faso's delegate at the Abidjan symposium of 10-12 December 2024: a national application for declaring births from health centres, the scanning of about 6 million existing acts in some forty communes, and an online e-service for requesting acts

note: Symposium report: the Burkina Faso passage describes a civil-status application and act scanning in some forty communes, the records row's subject; it says nothing of the communes' office connection.
